title: Investigating the Influence of Language on Sycophantic Behavior of Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the variation in sycophantic behavior (agree, disagree, or neutral stances) of LLMs across six different languages using translated opinion prompts, stance classification via an LLM judge, and calculating a novel Language-Exclusive Sycophancy (LES) metric.

Conducting topic-level analysis of Language-Exclusive Sycophancy (LES) on sensitive topics like abortion, feminism, and atheism to reveal how models selectively endorse beliefs mirroring the dominant ideological and cultural norms of a specific language community.
